title: Chandigarh's missing Sector 13 and what an address change does
text:
Names and numbers on a city map shape how a locality is seen by buyers, lenders and the market.
Chandigarh had no Sector 13 until February 2020, when the UT notified the old town of Manimajra as Sector 13 (The Tribune; DNA). UT records cited by the Daily Pioneer say the land for 12 and 13 was first marked as a cultural zone, and 13 never got an area of its own.
The same notification also renamed Dhanas, Maloya and the Industrial Area phases, bringing older pockets into the city's sector system.
In your experience, does a new sector name change how buyers and lenders look at an older locality?
